title: Full menu migration with Replace Item Library (gated, with caveat sweep)
summary: Replace deletes the entire library first — Square also does NOT carry display groups, advanced modifier settings, or auto-add across accounts. This flow forces backup, written approval, import, and a settings re-check sweep.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: a file under data/imports/ (a repo fixture is resolved as a fallback so the example runs)

steps.title: Export the current library (rollback = re-import this)
steps.instructions: Items > Export > CSV; store the file with the approval ref.

steps.title: Written approval for REPLACE (library destruction follows)
steps.instructions: Replace Item Library deletes ALL existing items before importing. Attach the approval reference, expected item counts, and the list of settings that will need re-doing afterward.

steps.title: Parse into the workbench with replace semantics
Drop referenced-but-empty modifier groups created by the CSV (fill-or-delete rule)
Re-apply restaurant-specific settings that do NOT transfer
steps.instructions: Recreate display groups, advanced modifier settings, and auto-add-to-check rules in the target account — CSV migration silently drops them.

steps.title: Confirm Replace + publish
steps.instructions: Only after the counts, audit, and settings sweep look right: Confirm import in Dashboard, then publish from this console.
